messages:
Iris: pic + tiny race update! Mochi the guinea pig completed the office tunnel course in 12.3s. video: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F33333/mochi_tunnel.mp4 :tada:

Noah: champion!!! 12.3s is Olympic level squeak speed :running_shoe: :squeak:

Yara: LOL the victory wiggle at the end. will Mochi accept a tiny medal or prefer extra cucumber slices? :cucumber:

Iris: poll time: 1) Medal (felt) 2) Cucumber slices 3) Both (medal for display, cucumber for fuel)

Ben: `/:three:` both. display items are important for morale.
Noah: `/:two:` cucumber only, medals are for humans. Mochi disagrees though.

PollBot: Poll created: "Mochi's prize?" Options: Medal (felt) / Cucumber slices / Both  Current: Medal 0, Cucumber slices 1, Both 1

Iris: added a slo-mo clip of the start (he sneezed, then zoom). official podium ceremony scheduled at 4pm by the plants. all fans welcome. :microphone:

Yara: bringing confetti (biodegradable) and a tiny ribbon. Mochi is getting his red carpet. :sparkles:

Ben: can we get a tiny leaderboard on the kitchen whiteboard? Mochi at the top. :white_large_square:

Iris: leaderboard drafted. current entries: Mochi 12.3s, Ava's hamster 14.1s (from last year), open category for wildcards. will post ceremony reminder. :trophy:
